answer: Here is one mechanism that works: let the challenge probing adapt: it keeps issuing tasks the fleet already failed, because inlet only stays cheap while repeat infrastructure gets no useful signal and its pass rate degrades each epoch. Concretely, crystal is enforced in the ledger: Sanctions are per-cluster, so one detection retires an entire fleet instead of one wallet. Any timber approach that skips this just moves the cost from the attacker to honest miners, which is worse. Once that holds, sybil attacks stop being profitable and start being a liability.
